concepts.problem: Compare neighboring values and repeatedly move the largest unsorted value to the end.
concepts.solution: Scan adjacent pairs, swap inverted values, and stop early when a pass makes no swap. Time O(n²), space O(1).

concepts.problem: Insert each new value into its correct position in the sorted prefix.
concepts.solution: Shift larger prefix values right until the insertion point is found. Time O(n²), space O(1).

concepts.problem: Select the smallest remaining value and place it at the next output position.
concepts.solution: Search the unsorted suffix for the minimum and swap once per position. Time O(n²), space O(1).

concepts.problem: Sort a sequence by splitting it, solving both halves, and merging ordered results.
concepts.solution: Use divide and conquer with two pointers during merge. Time O(n log n), space O(n).

concepts.problem: Partition values around a pivot so recursive ranges become smaller.
concepts.solution: Place elements on the correct side of a pivot, then recurse on both partitions. Average O(n log n), stack O(log n).

concepts.problem: Find a target or boundary in sorted data without scanning every element.
concepts.solution: Maintain a closed search interval and discard half after each comparison. Time O(log n), space O(1).

concepts.problem: Find two values whose combined result matches a target.
concepts.solution: Store previously seen values in a hash map and look up each complement. Average O(n), space O(n).

concepts.problem: Generate or count valid subsequences while preserving element order.
concepts.solution: At each index, branch into take and skip decisions, then combine valid states.

concepts.problem: Visit every node in the required order and process its subtree results.
concepts.solution: Choose recursive or stack-based DFS/BFS according to the traversal order. Time O(n), space O(h).

concepts.problem: Maintain the best k candidates while processing a stream or collection.
concepts.solution: Use a min or max heap so insertion and removal stay O(log k); total O(n log k).

concepts.problem: Find the longest or shortest valid contiguous range under a constraint.
concepts.solution: Expand the right edge, repair the constraint from the left, and track the best range. Time O(n).

concepts.problem: Determine whether opening and closing symbols form a valid nesting sequence.
concepts.solution: Push openings and match every closing symbol against the stack top. Time O(n), space O(n).

concepts.problem: Identify prime numbers or factor a value efficiently.
concepts.solution: Mark multiples from each unmarked base up to the square root. Sieve time O(n log log n).
